Blokları 8x8 ızgaraya yerleştir, satır v: Place blocks on the 8x8 grid and clear rows and columns! A 45-level adventure, stars, themes and a daily puzzle. Free, no download
Yerleştirilecek parçalar. Parçayı sürükl: Pieces to place. Drag a piece, or tap it and then tap a cell on the grid
Alttaki üç blok parçasını sürükleyerek 8: Drag the three block pieces at the bottom onto the 8x8 grid. When a row or column is completely full it clears and you score points. Each cell you place is worth 1 point and each cleared line 10 points. Clear several lines in one move and your points multiply: two lines are worth double, three lines triple. Clear lines on consecutive moves for a streak bonus. Pieces can't be rotated; once all three are placed, a new set arrives. The game ends when none of your pieces fit on the grid. While dragging, the cells where the piece will land and the lines that will clear light up, so you can see your move before letting go. On a phone the piece floats a little above your finger so you can see where it goes. You can also tap a piece once and then tap a cell on the grid to place it
<strong>Klavye:</strong> 1, 2 ve 3 tuşla: Keyboard: pick a piece with 1, 2 and 3, move it on the grid with the arrow keys (a preview is shown) and place it with Enter or Space. Esc cancels the selection and R restarts the game.
Macera üç dünyada toplam 45 bölümden olu: The adventure has 45 levels across three worlds. In Garden you aim for a target score; the first levels teach the basics with small pieces, then partly filled grids appear. In Mine you collect 💎 diamonds buried in the grid by clearing their row or column. In Ice Castle, 🔒 locked cells only disappear after being cleared twice: the first clear cracks the lock 🔓 and the second removes the cell. Every level has a move limit. Reaching the goal gives 1 star, and finishing with moves to spare gives 2 or 3 stars. The next world opens once you collect 30 stars in the previous one. Your stars unlock the Candy, Wood, Neon and Night block themes. Every level you finish with 3 stars earns you a helper (up to five of each): 🔀 Shuffle swaps your pieces and 🧹 Erase removes a single filled cell. In classic mode you can collect badges for 1000, 2500, 5000 and 10000 points
Izgaranın ortasını boş tutmaya çalış; bü: Try to keep the middle of the grid empty; big 3x3 squares and 5-long bars only fit in wide gaps. Look at all three pieces before placing any and put the hardest one first. Placing small pieces along the edges and corners protects the middle. Fill several lines together so you can clear them at once, as the multiplier boosts your score fast. Don't leave single-cell holes; only a single square can fill them. In adventure mode keep an eye on your remaining moves, since finishing early earns extra stars. Fill the lines with diamonds and locks first
<strong>Klasik modda Kolay ile Normal ar: What is the difference between Easy and Normal in classic mode? In Easy the big pieces never appear. In Normal, big and tricky shapes come more often as your score rises. Does everyone play the same levels? The starting grid, diamonds and locks are the same for everyone in each level; the pieces you get change with every try. Will I lose my progress? No, your stars, themes, helpers and badges are saved automatically in this browser. How is the daily puzzle scored? Everyone plays that day with the same starting grid and the same sequence of pieces, and the highest score wins.
